title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Just Put Two Fan-Favorite Characters in Serious Trouble
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has returned this month with its latest monthly chapter, and Chapter 36 features major developments, with two major characters finding themselves in serious trouble. Ever since the battle against Mamushi came to an end, the series has spent the last few chapters expanding its lore.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga unveiled additional cast and the theme song artists on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Anime Reveals More Cast, Theme Song Artists
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Nazuna Miki and artist Tsukasa Araki 's So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ( Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ) manga announced three more cast members and the theme song artists on Wednesday.

title: Agri Uma's Studio Cabana Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Agri Uma 's Studio Cabana manga is inspiring a television anime next year. Sayumi Suzushiro plays protagonist Yukari Maki, reprising her role from a 2022 promotional video for the manga.

title: ippatu's Shōjōhime Manga Moves to YanMaga Web on August 2
content: This year's 34th issue of Kodansha 's Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that ippatu 's Shōjōhime (Monkey Princess) manga will move to Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website, where it is simultaneously serialized, on August 2. The manga will also start its new arc in its next chapter.

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film's Trailer Unveils Theme Song, More Cast
content: The official website for To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, unveiled the full trailer, key visual, theme song artist, and more cast members on Wednesday. The trailer previews the theme song "Olive" by musician Tota .
